editionData.title: Iran says Hormuz deal with Oman won’t fully reopen strait; U.S.-Canada relations go up in smoke
editionData.description: Global headlines: Iran says Hormuz deal with Oman won’t fully reopen strait (Oil prices jumped after the comments by senior Iranian officials on the talks to manage traffic through the waterway); U.S.-Canada relations go up in smoke (There’s been something in the air in D.C. this summer — namely wildfire smoke and frustration over Canada’s inability to keep it on its side of the border); and Ukraine fails to halt Russian barrage as Zelensky blames partners for ‘horrific casualties’ (U.S.-made systems are Kyiv’s only means to shoot down ballistic missiles, and Ukraine says it has run out of interceptors. Seventeen Ukrainians died overnight). Markets leaned lower, with 5 of 7 tracked indexes down; HANG SENG INDEX down 1.49% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon (Early tech demos show model-specific integrated circuits churning out up to 17,000 tokens a second); Hackers Stalked Me by Hijacking a Smartwatch for Kids (Security researchers tracked and eavesdropped on a WIRED reporter using vulnerabilities in a pink plastic smartwatch. It’s just one piece...); and Mario Meets Pareto (Discover how to find the best Mario Kart 8 build using the Pareto frontier method. This interactive guide explores multi-objective...). Product Hunt features Cloudflare OS (Build the AI operating system for your company), AI Spend Console by Rippling (Track your AI spend and connect it to business outcomes), and CopilotKit Channels SDK (Bring any agent to Slack, Teams, and more).

headlines.title: Iran says Hormuz deal with Oman won’t fully reopen strait
headlines.summary: Oil prices jumped after the comments by senior Iranian officials on the talks to manage traffic through the waterway.

headlines.title: U.S.-Canada relations go up in smoke
headlines.summary: There’s been something in the air in D.C. this summer — namely wildfire smoke and frustration over Canada’s inability to keep it on its side of the border.

headlines.title: Ukraine fails to halt Russian barrage as Zelensky blames partners for ‘horrific casualties’
headlines.summary: U.S.-made systems are Kyiv’s only means to shoot down ballistic missiles, and Ukraine says it has run out of interceptors. Seventeen Ukrainians died overnight.

headlines.title: With support for Israel roiling U.S. politics, Israelis fear a permanent shift
headlines.summary: Abdul El-Sayed’s victory in Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary adds to a string of upsets that reflect growing criticism of Israel.

headlines.title: Israel’s killing of journalist Amal Khalil was a war crime, rights group says
headlines.summary: The reporter died during an Israeli strike in April in Lebanon. The IDF said that it was targeting Hezbollah and that it does not target journalists.

headlines.title: Anti-Muslim US Congressman Andy Ogles loses congressional primary
headlines.summary: Trump's endorsement fails to save Tennessee legislator who recently said 'Muslims don't belong in American society'.

headlines.title: Israeli raid in West Bank’s Qalandiya injures 51 Palestinians
headlines.summary: Israeli forces arrest dozens of Palestinians near Jerusalem amid uptick in military and settler violence in West Bank.

headlines.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harm to youths
headlines.summary: The ruling comes in the second phase of a landmark trial, with the Instagram, Facebook owner also losing in March.

headlines.title: Brazil formally accuses 16 people over 2024 Voepass deadly plane crash
headlines.summary: Official says plane was irregularly cleared for departure before crash that killed 62 people outside Sao Paulo.

headlines.title: After the floods, hunger: Mozambique’s second disaster
headlines.summary: Lost harvests and disrupted supply routes have pushed many families deeper into food insecurity.

headlines.title: Trump signs 2 immigration actions to curb 'birth tourism,' limit birthright citizenship
headlines.summary: Additional details weren't provided, but Trump said he thought his latest actions would be constitutional.

headlines.title: Iran aims to ban U.S. and Israeli ships from Strait of Hormuz and charge others a toll
headlines.summary: Iran's parliament is reviewing a plan to ban ships linked to the U.S., Israel and other "hostile countries" from transiting the Strait of Hormuz. The Trump administration has rejected the plan.

headlines.title: A look at 'Operation Country Roads,' West Virginia's ICE operation
headlines.summary: Earlier this year ICE arrested 600 immigrants over a two week period. Most migrants had no criminal records and, since then, West Virginia has decided to not hold ICE detainees in their jails. A look at West Virginia post Operation Country Roads.

headlines.title: Sticky or slippery? Snails can change their slime to meet the moment
headlines.summary: Snails are slimy. But there's more to that goo of theirs than meets the eye. It's a fact that may help inspire the creation of new materials.

headlines.title: The park service says Trump's arch would obstruct historic sites. Could it be moved?
headlines.summary: President Trump's proposed arch in Memorial Circle would intrude on dozens of nearby sites, says the National Park Service. But there's been minimal discussion of alternate locations.

headlines.title: Europe's nuclear sector feels drought impact
headlines.summary: The full threat of the extreme heat and drought conditions affecting much of Europe this summer has been expressed in the starkest terms after it was revealed that at least 15 nuclear reactors across the continent have had to be temporarily shut down or operate at reduced output.

headlines.title: Gazans face intense Israeli violence, child death toll mounts: UN
headlines.summary: UNITED NATIONS - Civilians in Gaza continue to face intense military strikes, shelling, gunfire and naval fire from Israel, among other threats to their safety, UN humanitarians said Thursday.

headlines.title: Potential seen for Sino-Thai tech cooperation
headlines.summary: Young Chinese entrepreneurs see growing opportunities for China-Thailand cooperation across a wide range of industries, particularly artificial intelligence and digital technologies, following a visit to Bangkok.

headlines.title: Ebola caseload in DR Congo tops 4,000
headlines.summary: KINSHASA - The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 4,053, including 1,850 deaths, according to an update released Thursday by the country's health authorities.

headlines.title: Japan's remarks trigger alarm
headlines.summary: Hiroshima marked the 81st anniversary of the atomic bombing by the United States with a memorial ceremony on Thursday, amid mounting domestic opposition to recent pro-nuclear remarks by senior Japanese officials.

headlines.title: INDIA bloc leaders likely to visit Bihar’s Siwan to meet injured protesters who suffered gunshot wounds
headlines.summary: INDIA bloc leaders plan to visit Bihar's Siwan to support injured protesters after police used AK-47s during demonstrations.

headlines.title: Form-7 misuse: Supreme Court to consider Congress MP’s plea alleging targeted deletions in U.P.
headlines.summary: Supreme Court to review Congress MP's plea on alleged misuse of Form-7 for targeted voter deletions in Uttar Pradesh.

headlines.summary: Union Cabinet approves ₹8,970 crore Guwahati-Tezpur NH-15 corridor, enhancing connectivity and reducing travel time across Assam.

headlines.title: Echo sentiments of Opposition to Home Minister: Rajya Sabha Chairman tells government

headlines.summary: Protesting students form an 11-member team to negotiate with the Jharkhand government over demands regarding competitive exam irregularities.

hackerNews.summary: A specially engineered chewing gum reduced HPV by up to 93% and nearly eliminated two bacteria linked to head and neck cancer. The treatment preserved beneficial mouth bacteria, raising hopes for a safer and more affordable therapy.
